13.1.1.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.1.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Add verification of light levels to internal audit checklist. Consider (although not compulsory) including a measure, target levels, and device.

13.1.2.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.2.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Ensure that procedures to maintain product safety and quality during storage include measures for protecting food in installed outdoor bulk vessels.

13.1.3.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.3.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Identify backflow prevention risk areas and devices. Add to periodic check program (at a minimum, recommend annual). Ensure disposal of sewage into adequate sewerage system or other adequate means.

13.1.4.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.4.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Recommend specifically adding verification of seam and weld integrity, and assessment of corrosion to post-cleaning or preoperational inspections. This should form part of the training for the individuals who perform these checks.

13.1.5.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.5.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Treat ice, whether internal or external, as an ingredient, with specifications and requiring verification against standards. Consider requiring ice suppliers to be certified to BRCGS, GFSI-benchmarked, or other equivalent standard. Internal ice manufacture should be treated as any other production area.

13.1.6.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.6.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Ensure procedures for raw material acceptance, monitoring and management include inspection activities to ensure raw materials and other ingredients are clean and suitable for processing. This must include washing of raw materials or ingredients to remove soil or other contamination as necessary and procedures to maintain product safety and quality during storage. Where water is reused for washing, rinsing, or conveying food, effective measures must be taken to ensure the water does not cause allergen cross-contact or increase the level of contamination.

13.1.7.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.7.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Ensure procedures for controlling non-conforming product include reconditioning protocols in accordance with the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.

13.1.8.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.8.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Ensure procedures related to the management of surplus food and products for animal feed include measures to prevent contamination of human food by-products for use as animal food during holding and distribution, including appropriate storage and shipping containers, identification, and labelling.

13.1.9.label: Modül maddesi karşılanıyor mu?
13.1.9.hint: 21 CFR 117.110 · BRCGS: NO EQUIVALENT OR RELATED CLAUSE

13.1.9.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.9.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Obtain a copy of the FDA Defect Action Level document. If ingredients or finished products are included in the DAL, ensure specifications at a minimum meet the expectations listed.

13.1.10.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.10.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Ensure that the risk assessment (either embedded in the HACCP risk analysis or as a separate analysis) includes risks from economic adulteration, environmental pathogens, and unintentional contamination. Specifically add ‘radiological’ to the risk category covering chemical risks.

13.1.11.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.11.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Similar to the CCPs, hazards requiring a preventive control or significant hazards should be identified. This is primarily a terminology change, which would require both CCPs and specific prerequisite programs to be in place to manage specific risks. It may also include supplier approval mechanisms.

13.1.12.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.12.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Where hazards are identified, adequate controls must be in place. Such controls may include precautionary labelling (labelling includes specifications) for subsequent users, even where the site’s finished product will be an ingredient at a different site. As an example, untreated flour could advise customers of the need to cook prior to consumer consumption.

13.1.13.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.13.hint: BRCGS önerisi: The recall plan should include the identified bullet points. The effectiveness of the plans should be assessed during the site mock recall.

13.1.14.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.14.hint: BRCGS önerisi: The supply-chain procedure shall include the receipt of the raw material or other ingredients from unapproved suppliers, preventive control management actions and responsibilities for the review of records and reanalysis of the food safety plan.

13.1.15.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.15.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Ensure the designated PCQI has oversight of verifications and that they are completed within 7 days of creation.

13.1.16.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.16.hint: BRCGS önerisi: A general procedure should be in place to capture affected product in the event that controls are not utilised or only partially utilised. This usually includes identifying the affected product, isolating it, and determining outcomes, which may include preventing it from entering into commerce where required.

13.1.17.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler

13.1.18.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler

13.1.19.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.19.hint: BRCGS önerisi: All control-related records should be reviewed within 7 days by the designated individual. Sufficient backup should be in place for the main PCQI to ensure coverage in case of absence. Record reviews should be dated.

13.1.20.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.20.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Sample and test methodology should follow industry-accepted practices, and reference to such practices should be part of the procedure.

13.1.21.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.21.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Sample sites and frequency of testing should be based on a risk assessment. Corrective action should include product disposition in the case of positive results, immediate correction (i.e. , reclean), and corrective action (i.e. , reassessment of cleaning procedures).

13.1.22.label: Modül maddesi karşılanıyor mu?
13.1.22.hint: 21 CFR 117.180 · BRCGS: NO EQUIVALENT OR RELATED CLAUSE

13.1.22.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.22.hint: BRCGS önerisi: There is a strong recommendation that at least one individual per site undertakes the recognised FSPCA PCQI training. Alternative training and qualifications that focus on food safety expertise, as well as an understanding of FSMA rules, may be acceptable. Ensure that there is written justification for the review of records of monitoring and corrective actions within a timeframe that exceeds 7 working days, as well as a determination that reanalysis can be completed, and additional preventive controls validated, as appropriate to the nature of the preventive control and its role in the facilities food safety system, in a timeframe that exceeds the first 90 calendar days of production of the applicable food.

13.1.23.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.23.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Ensure that records identify all bullet points, specifically the site and traceability to specific product lots.

13.1.24.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.24.hint: BRCGS önerisi: The senior manager must review the food safety plan or be present during the annual management review.

13.1.25.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.25.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Ensure that the record retention policy identifies which records are to be kept, and that they are kept for at least 2 years.

13.1.26.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.26.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Regardless of how many times a required control is applied prior to being received at a site, the receiving site is responsible for verifying that the control has been applied. As an example, when cooked chicken is received (with no additional kill step required by the receiving facility), the site where the cook step takes place must be included in supplier verification, specifically verifying controls around the cook step.

13.1.27.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.27.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Do not accept the supplier verification activities as described in 21 CFR § 117.415 and listed in the guidance above. Ensure this is documented in the raw material supplier approval and monitoring procedures.

13.1.28.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
13.1.28.hint: BRCGS önerisi: Ensure the raw material risk assessment identifies all raw materials or ingredients in which a hazard will be controlled by the supplier and is one for which there is a reasonable probability that exposure to the hazard will result in serious adverse health consequences or death to humans. The requirement to conduct an onsite audit of suppliers of the applicable raw materials and ingredients before using them, and at least annually thereafter should be included in the supplier and raw material approval and performance monitoring procedures. The procedures should also describe when written determination that other verification activities and/or less frequent onsite auditing of the supplier provide adequate assurance that the hazards are controlled would be appropriate.

13.1.29.label: Modül maddesi karşılanıyor mu?
13.1.29.hint: 21 CFR 117.430 · BRCGS: NO EQUIVALENT OR RELATED CLAUSE

13.1.29.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler

13.1.30.label: Objektif kanıt: incelenen doküman, kayıt ve gözlemler
